official_sources: GOV.UK when permission is required - NDO
Town and Country Planning Act 1990 sections 61E-61Q
official_measurement_examples: made NDO can grant planning permission for specified development in specified neighbourhood area
draft NDO is not planning permission
CRTBO is a form of NDO for small-scale community-benefit development
NDO can be conditional or unconditional but scope and conditions must match
Schedule 1 EIA development cannot be granted through NDO
environmental consultation duties can apply before order is made
NDO does not remove listed-building or other separate statutory protections
NDO permission does not establish land ownership or final development yield
core_rules: draft NDO is not made NDO
made order scope must match site and development
NDO can grant planning permission but not other consents
CRTBO is not generic neighbourhood plan
Schedule1 EIA cannot be NDO development
NDO does not establish access rights
historic order is not proof of current effect
order boundary is not cadastral ownership boundary
NDO does not prove infrastructure capacity
no parcel NDO clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
